newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: High grown tea prices rise at Colombo auction.
newsitem.headline: High grown tea prices rise at Colombo auction.

text.p: High grown tea prices rose at the Colombo auction on Wednesday on very strong demand from the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), brokers said.
"The CIS is going strong on high growns," said a broker. "We have our own branded packs doing very well in the CIS."
Brokers Forbes and Walker said the anticipated gross auction average price for the 4.7 million kg on offer should rise to 120 rupees ($2.13) per kg from 117.81 rupees last week.
The next auction is on October 1-2 where 4.5 million kg will be on offer.
